visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, silver-grey hair wearing a tan open jacket over a black dress stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. In front of her on a white table are three colorful mahjong cases: one black with Mickey Mouse ears, one red with the MARVEL logo, and one bright green with a three-eyed Toy Story alien face. A male hand enters from the right, gesturing towards the cases as the woman smiles and talks animatedly. (2) The scene cuts as the woman and the cameraman focus on the green Alien-themed case. The woman picks it up to show the front, which features a large graphic of a Toy Story Alien's eyes and mouth. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant colors of the plastic cases. (3) They open the green case to reveal specialized mahjong tiles. Each tile is light blue and features illustrations of planets and aliens. The camera zooms in to show a close-up of the tiles as a finger points to the intricate designs. The background remains the simple white walls of the indoor setting with a dark couch visible. (4) Transitioning to the red Marvel-themed case, the woman unlatches it. Inside, the tiles are white with red and black illustrations of various Marvel superheroes like Captain America and Black Widow. The case itself looks like a sturdy briefcase with metal latches and foam inserts. (5) The cameraman pulls out a black magnetic ruler from the Marvel set, showing the Avengers 'A' logo on a circuit-patterned background. The woman continues to talk, her expressions varying from excitement to focused explanation as she handles the components. (6) Next, they showcase the Mickey Mouse themed case, which is black and red. Inside, the tiles feature Mickey and Minnie Mouse silhouettes. The camera captures the glossy finish of the tiles and the detailed engraving of the character heads. (7) Returning to a wider shot, the woman stands behind all three sets. Large green and yellow text overlays appear, providing discount information and a website link. She uses expansive hand gestures to emphasize the special offer. (8) A large QR code appears in the center of the screen as the woman poses and makes heart gestures with her hands. The text provides a price of $3990 and a deadline of October. She remains energetic and smiling until the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy dialogue between a male and a female over an upbeat, synthetic electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. The male speaker's pitch is moderate while the female speaker's pitch is higher and more varied. (2) A sharp mechanical click sounds as the first mahjong case is unlatched. This is followed by the rhythmic, percussive shuffling of tiles being moved inside the box. The male voice expresses loud enthusiasm with a rising intonation. (3) Continuous background music maintains a bright, happy atmosphere. The female voice speaks rapidly, explaining the features of the mahjong set. Incidental sounds of plastic tiles clicking against each other are frequent. (4) As the Marvel-themed case is handled, another metallic latch click is audible. The dialogue shifts to specific character names, spoken with clear articulation and high arousal. The music continues without pause, keeping the pace fast. (5) Promotional details are introduced with increased vocal volume and projection. A subtle 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the appearance of the discount code. The speakers overlap slightly in their excitement, creating a dense audio texture. (6) The video concludes with high-pitched exclamations from the female speaker, while the BGM remains at a consistent level before fading out abruptly with the final hard cut.
